title: ループハンドル付きの草刈りトリマー
description: 公園の縁や庭の草刈り場面に使う長軸トリマー。斜めの金属シャフト、分割継手、開口ループハンドル、上部グリップとモーター外装、曲面ガード、スプールと短い固定ナイロン線を備えます。電池・電源コード・草・内部駆動部は付属せず、回転・切断動作・性能・安全認証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.146 × 1.579 × 0.446 m、9,344三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A long-shaft string trimmer for park edges and garden-care scenes, with an angled metal shaft, coupling, open loop handle, upper grip and motor exterior, curved guard, spool and short fixed nylon-line ends. Battery, power cord, grass and working internals are omitted; no spinning, cutting behavior, performance or safety certification is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.146 × 1.579 × 0.446 m; 9,344 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
